terms.title: About NUERS and these terms
paragraphs: NUERS provides account registration, business and taxpayer records, electronic invoice and receipt workflows, document verification, reporting and support. These terms apply to visitors, account holders and authorized representatives using this installation. The service operator identifies itself as NUERS. Contact: nuersofficial@gmail.com.

An account, logo, QR code, document preview or recorded transaction is not proof of BIR accreditation, taxpayer registration, authorization to print or transmit, or acceptance by BIR. Official status depends on the applicable authorization and genuine recorded evidence.

terms.title: Your account and business registration
paragraphs: Provide accurate information and register only a business you are authorized to represent. Use the registered business name, TIN and branch code, address, industry and RDO appearing in your records. An address-based RDO match is a convenience; check it against your BIR registration. Contact support if it differs.

Business registration creates a pending-review record. Email verification confirms access to an email address when actual mail delivery is configured; it does not authenticate a TIN or approve a business. Local development codes are labelled as test verification and do not mark the email as verified.

Protect your password, API credentials, verification codes and browser session. Do not share accounts, impersonate another person or use another business’s records. Access depends on your role and the permissions granted to you. Report suspected unauthorized access promptly.

terms.title: Invoices, receipts and tax responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for the accuracy, completeness, lawful use and required retention of the documents and customer information you enter or import. Review buyer details, item descriptions, tax treatment, calculations and totals before issuing or sharing a document.

Drafts, issued documents, cancellations, transmission readiness and BIR acknowledgments represent different stages. A saved document or successful local validation does not establish BIR acceptance. Use the documented correction or cancellation process where available and preserve the underlying audit trail.
NUERS supports compliance work; it does not replace your responsibility to obtain permits, make required filings, pay taxes or seek professional advice when needed.

terms.title: Transaction fees and record storage
paragraphs: NUERS uses transaction-based pricing with no subscription or recurring subscription fee. The current published service fee applies once per eligible finalized sale of ₱500 and above, deducted from the merchant’s prepaid wallet at NUERS acceptance. Super Admin rate changes apply prospectively; previous ledger entries retain their original fee and pricing revision. Transactions below ₱500 have no NUERS transaction service fee. This is a flat fee, not a percentage: ₱499.99 has no service fee; ₱500 and ₱5,000 each have the same published flat service fee. A request with insufficient funds is not accepted; the client must retain the original source and retry after funding. Payment copies, adjustments and accepted retries do not create an additional sale fee.

All NUERS business accounts include unlimited record storage with five-year record retention. No subscription plan or storage tier is required. The registration workflow records the applicable pricing terms; registration and the public fee calculator do not process payment.

NUERS service fees are separate from the transaction amount. Any payment-provider charges are separate. Charges or changes affecting an existing paid arrangement must be communicated and agreed before collection.

The five-year storage offer is a service term. It does not override applicable recordkeeping obligations, lawful holds or authorized migration requirements. Preserve independent copies where required and contact NUERS for record export or end-of-term arrangements. Records are not automatically deleted solely because this advertised term changes.

terms.title: Acceptable use and integrations
paragraphs: Do not submit fraudulent documents, unlawful content, malicious files or messages, scrape private records, circumvent access controls, overload the service, or use credentials outside their authorized scope. Use APIs and integrations only for the businesses and purposes you are permitted to support.

Follow documented validation, rate limits and retry behavior. Avoid repeated submissions of the same financial document. Access may be restricted where necessary to investigate abuse, protect records, comply with law or address an account authorization issue.

terms.title: Support and communications
paragraphs: Use the website chat widget or email nuersofficial@gmail.com for support. Chat messages are saved for administrator review; replies appear in the same browser conversation. Automated email or SMS notifications and a guaranteed response time are not included in this chat implementation.

Do not send passwords, OTPs, API keys, full TINs, payment-card details or unnecessary customer information in a support message. Only authorized administrators can use the support inbox. Starting a new browser conversation removes the browser’s link to the previous conversation; it does not delete the server record.

terms.title: Availability, changes and account closure
paragraphs: Availability depends on the deployed infrastructure and enabled integrations. No particular uptime, disaster recovery, automatic BIR transmission or continuous human monitoring is promised by these pages. Planned functionality in the specification is not automatically an available feature.

Contact NUERS to correct an account, request a permitted export or discuss closure. Closing access does not automatically erase documents, audit evidence, support messages, legal holds or records that must be retained. Requests are handled in accordance with the Privacy Notice and applicable obligations.

Changes to these terms will carry a new version and effective date. Where a change requires renewed agreement or affects an existing paid arrangement, NUERS will present the change for the applicable acceptance process. Materially different processing cannot be justified merely by an old checkbox.

terms.title: Privacy, applicable law and questions
paragraphs: Read the Privacy Notice for the information collected, purposes, recipients, retention and available rights. Acceptance of these terms is separate from an acknowledgment that the Privacy Notice has been provided. Neither is blanket permission for unrelated marketing or unlawful disclosure.

These terms are intended for the Philippine NUERS service and are subject to applicable Philippine law. Nothing in them removes rights or obligations that cannot lawfully be excluded. Direct service or privacy questions to nuersofficial@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Who handles your information
paragraphs: This notice describes information processed through NUERS account registration, business and electronic document workflows, website verification and the support chat. The service operator identifies itself as NUERS. For questions or rights requests, contact nuersofficial@gmail.com with the subject “Privacy request — NUERS”.

A business using NUERS remains responsible for the customer, employee and transaction data it decides to collect and upload. NUERS processes that information to provide the configured service. The parties’ controller/processor responsibilities for a production business deployment must be defined by the applicable service arrangement.

privacy.title: What the system collects
paragraphs: Account and registration information: name, email, password hash, business name, TIN and branch code, structured address and ZIP code, industry/activity, business type, RDO, VAT status, representative name and position, mobile number, pricing-terms snapshot, notice versions and agreement timestamps.

Document information, when supplied: seller and buyer identifiers and contact details, invoice or receipt numbers, line items, amounts, taxes, payment method and transaction status. The system may also store related import, transmission, acknowledgment, exception and audit records where those workflows are used.

Support information: optional name and email, topic, message contents, timestamps, associated signed-in account where available, message identifiers, read markers, assignment, priority, status and administrator action history.

Technical information: session and API credentials used by the application, browser-held preferences and chat access credentials, security/audit events and server logs generated by the installation. Email verification records contain code hashes, attempt counts, expiry, verification proof hashes and delivery mode.

privacy.title: Why information is processed
paragraphs: NUERS uses information to create and administer accounts, review business registrations, organize records, provide invoice and receipt workflows, show verification results, support enabled integrations, respond to support requests, reconcile errors and protect the service.

Processing must have an appropriate lawful basis. Depending on the activity, this may include providing a requested service or preparing an agreement, complying with a legal obligation, proportionate legitimate interests such as security, or specific consent where required. TINs and other protected identifiers require the applicable safeguards and lawful basis; one registration checkbox does not authorize every later use.

Required registration fields are needed to complete the business-account workflow. Chat name/email are optional. No subscription selection is required. A chat message and topic are needed to ask for support. Do not provide another person’s information unless you are authorized and have given any required notice.

privacy.title: Who may receive or access information
paragraphs: Authorized account administrators and personnel handling business review or support may access information needed for their role. A business’s permitted users may access that business’s records through the configured account workflows.

Configured hosting, database, backup, email and integration providers may process information necessary to operate their services. A genuine BIR transmission or other legal disclosure requires its own enabled workflow and applicable authority; saving a registration or chat message does not itself send an invoice to BIR.

Anyone holding a document verification link or QR code may be able to see the identifiers, amounts, issue information, recorded status and other details returned by the verification service. Share these links only with intended recipients. A chat conversation’s private browser token provides access to its messages; do not share that token or use a shared browser without signing out and securing it.

Emailing the published Gmail address uses your email service and Google’s email infrastructure. The chat itself stores messages in the NUERS database; it does not automatically email or text them to staff or visitors.

privacy.title: Storage, retention and deletion
paragraphs: This installation stores operational records in its configured database and server files. Hosting country, production processors, cross-border arrangements and backup locations depend on the actual deployment; these pages do not represent a certification of Philippine-only hosting.

Records should be kept only for the relevant service, security, accounting, dispute or legal purpose and any required retention or legal hold. Account closure or resolution of a support thread is not automatic deletion. This implementation does not yet run an automatic purge schedule for chat, account records or expired verification rows.

Email codes stop working after ten minutes and are limited to five attempts; expired code records may remain until administrator cleanup. Chat access tokens expire after ninety days; expiry removes token access, not the underlying message history. Browser storage may retain the token until it is cleared or a new conversation is started.

NUERS includes unlimited storage with five-year record retention for all business accounts, without a subscription. This service offer is distinct from lawful data-retention requirements. A pricing update does not automatically delete records. Contact NUERS for retention, export or closure arrangements.

privacy.title: Security and browser storage
paragraphs: Passwords are stored as hashes. Email codes, verification proofs and support conversation tokens are hashed in the database. Admin support endpoints check the authenticated user’s role; conversation access is checked against its private token. These controls reduce risk but do not make a promise of absolute security.

The application stores an account access token in browser local storage for authenticated API requests. The support widget stores its conversation ID and private token in local storage to resume the thread on that browser. Opening the widget may poll for updates; authorized administrators’ inboxes also poll for new messages.

Use a trusted device, protect browser sessions and report suspected misuse. Do not put credentials or unnecessary identifying information into chat. Infrastructure security, backups, encryption settings and incident response depend on the deployed configuration and must be maintained by the operator.

privacy.title: Your rights and how to request help
paragraphs: Subject to the Data Privacy Act and applicable conditions, you may have rights to be informed, access information, correct inaccuracies, object to processing, request erasure or blocking, obtain portability, seek compensation and lodge a complaint. A request may be limited by an applicable legal duty, another person’s rights or a justified retention requirement.

Email nuersofficial@gmail.com with the type of request and an account email or registration/conversation reference sufficient to locate the record. Do not send a password or OTP. NUERS may need proportionate identity or authorization checks before disclosing or changing information. If you withdraw consent, processing that relies solely on it must be reviewed; withdrawal does not undo lawful past processing or a separate legal obligation.
You may also contact the National Privacy Commission through its official website, privacy.gov.ph, for information about rights or complaints.

privacy.title: Local development and changes to this notice
paragraphs: When this installation runs in local development with the log mailer, verification emails and their codes are written to the configured application log instead of being delivered. A labelled test code is shown only in that local mode, and the email address is not marked verified. Access to development databases, logs and backups must be limited appropriately.

NUERS records the version of this notice acknowledged during business registration. Updates will show a new version and effective date. New purposes, recipients or processing requiring additional notice or consent must be addressed before that processing begins.
